title: VTCCallEndEvent not delivered to backgrounded iOS — CallKit UI lingers
description: VTC spec line 1290: server delivers VTCRingEvent via WebSocket AND VTCCallPush via APNs. If callee answers on desktop (WebSocket), iOS device also received VoIP push showing CallKit UI. VTCCallEndEvent with answered_elsewhere dismisses it — but only over WebSocket. Backgrounded iOS with no WebSocket never gets it. CallKit UI lingers until push TTL expires (30-60s).
